supervisor_summary: Five revised forecasts put Cerebras at $110-126 (mean $119.9) against a $148.86 spot. They converged mostly on my round-1 corrections, so I re-checked each at source: share count (284.9M), RPO bands, guidance, consensus and rates held, but the peer multiples were aggregator ratios; rebuilt from filings and named consensus they put the 9-peer NTM EV/sales median at 11.56x and the neoclouds at 3.1-5.5x. My reconciled model now gives $96 (4.8x horizon NTM sales on ~$5.0B, re-derived after the gate with operating leases in the neocloud EVs, the horizon revenue mix and a proportional discount, plus a 14.8%-WACC DCF). It funds a heavier 2027 build, which leaves ~$3.6B net cash at the horizon; with the undrawn $850M general-purpose revolver the raise risk is ~25%. It credits interest income the engine omits. The ladder blends the forecasters' mean with the corrected engine (P(>= $149) = 0.30) with a $90 thesis break. Cerebras is not a defense name on the filings (no defense revenue disclosed; ceiling 14% of FY2025). Its material weaknesses are confirmed and still unremediated in the June 10-Q.
key_drivers: Conversion of the $25.4B RPO (22% by mid-2028, 43% in months 25-48; 10-Q), mostly the OpenAI 750 MW MRA, sets FY2028 revenue (~$5.6B) and the horizon NTM base (~$5.0B).

Horizon multiple: 4.8x NTM EV/sales = 80/20 horizon mix of the lease-inclusive neocloud pair (4.73x) and chip/networking median (11.87x), less a 19.5% growth/concentration discount and Cerebras's own leases (0.11x); 9-peer ex-lease NTM median 11.56x; each 1x is ~$17.6 a share.

Funding the build: H1 2026 capex $549M (Q2 $417M) against $7.0B net cash; net cash falls to ~$3.6B at the horizon and ~$2.3B at end-2028 on this set. The undrawn $850M revolver may be used for general corporate purposes (10-Q), so a 2027-28 raise is a live but smaller risk (~25%).
Margin path: core GM 41% in Q2, guided 38-40% for Q3; GAAP EBIT turns positive only in FY2028; SBC ~$593M in FY2026.
Supply and governance: final lock-up expiry by Nov 9; material weaknesses still unremediated in the Q2 10-Q.
